description.en:
R1-D is Unitree's dual-arm humanoid platform for manipulation and interaction development. It offers alternative mounting arrangements and arm configurations, including five- and seven-degree-of-freedom options, with articulated head and waist components depending on the version.

The platform provides camera, audio and robot-control interfaces for building applications. Its vision module exposes RGB and depth information, while microphones and speakers support spoken interaction. End interfaces allow different grippers or other tools to be fitted. R1-D is intended for developers who need a configurable upper-body system, with the exact workspace and capabilities determined by the mounting, arms and end effectors selected.
